info.title: IWBTGR Tribute Edition
info.author: shaman
info.details:
I Wanna Be The Guy: Remastered Tribute Edition is fan-made version 1.6.6.6 of I Wanna Be The Guy: Remastered by Cherry Treehouse, on the Switch. Same brutal classic, plus new ways to suffer.

- The full IWBTG: Remastered.
- Tribute Mode: play as the Tribute Kid, with some extra secrets to find.
- Over a dozen language options.
- Secrets and hidden extras for the truly stubborn.

Start it from the Homebrew Menu in title-override mode (hold R while starting a game) so it gets the full memory. Applet mode also works. B jump, Y shoot, X restart, + pause, A back, menus confirm with B. Controls can be remapped in Options. Saves go to /switch/iwbtgrt/save. To quit, press HOME and close the software.

Credits: I Wanna Be The Guy by Michael "Kayin" O'Reilly. I Wanna Be The Guy: Remastered by Cherry Treehouse. I Wanna be the Tribute, and the 1.6.6.6 patch and extras, by shaman. Free fan project, not affiliated with Kayin or Cherry Treehouse.

changelog: 1.6.6.6\nFirst Switch release. Docked and handheld at 1280x720, Joy-Con and Pro Controller, remappable controls.
